knowledge_point.title: Determining the Dimensions of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix $A$, where
$A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6\end{bmatrix}?$
question.:question/worked-solution: The matrix $A$ has $2$ rows and $3$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $2\times 3.$
